bench_e2e_gpu_batch_proof.title: E2E resident GPU batch proof vs SIMD and minimap2
bench_e2e_gpu_batch_proof.description: Focused non-rejection comparison for the selected all-GPU path. This benchmark uses batch_pair_mode so mmsearch(seq, query_seq) produces a true multi-query custom-scan batch. The GPU row is accepted only when the Vulkan batch branch is taken, CPU/SIMD fallback rows are zero, Vulkan declines are zero, and every query maps correctly.

test_case_descriptions.E2E_2GBP_DNA4: dna4 2 Gbp reference, one 5 Mbp HiFi-error query (DOC0283 seed)
test_case_descriptions.E2E_2GBP_DNA5: dna5 2 Gbp reference with deterministic N bases; same biological parameters as dna4
test_case_descriptions.E2E_4GBP_DNA4: dna4 4 Gbp reference, one 5 Mbp HiFi-error query; minimap2 ref split into two records
test_case_descriptions.E2E_4GBP_DNA5: dna5 4 Gbp reference with deterministic N bases; same biological parameters as dna4
test_case_descriptions.E2E_GPU_BATCH_16_300M_SEG_COORD: 16 dna4 same-relation coordinate queries against one 300 Mbp target; default proof case where the selected Vulkan GPU batch path must run with zero CPU/SIMD fallback and zero Vulkan declines
